name: Arx Pounder
axis_orientation: Rear-end is the engine and troop ramp, front-end is the gun muzzle
operating_principle: The vehicle provides mobile indirect fire support, with a turret-mounted gun and a crew of two. It uses a digital fire control system and can rapidly come into and out of action.

components.description: The primary structure of the vehicle, providing protection for the crew and components.
The rotating structure that houses the main gun and fire control systems.
The engine and transmission system that powers the vehicle.
The system that transmits power from the engine to the wheels.
The components that make up the wheel suspension and steering system.
The system that connects the wheels to the hull and provides a smooth ride.
The area that houses the crew and provides protection from enemy fire.
The components that provide the crew with visibility and targeting information.
